compact/posix/pi/ollama-embed/orcarouter.html: # Keep generated configuration files out of version control. echo .chunkhound.json >> .gitignore echo .mcp.json >> .gitignore # Configure ChunkHound with Ollama embeddings and OrcaRouter for research. Embedding and LLM providers are independent — either works without the other. Field details: https://chunkhound.ai/docs/configuration/ # You'll need: OrcaRouter API key cat > .chunkhound.json <<'CHUNKHOUND_EOF' { "embedding": { "provider": "openai", "model": "qwen3-embedding", "base_url": "http://localhost:11434/v1" }, "llm": { "provider": "orcarouter", "model": "qwen/qwen3.7-flash", "api_key": "<YOUR_ORCAROUTER_API_KEY>" } } CHUNKHOUND_EOF # Configure Pi to connect to ChunkHound via MCP. pi install npm:pi-mcp-adapter if [ -f .mcp.json ]; then cat <<'CHUNKHOUND_EOF' .mcp.json already exists — merge this block into it manually: { "mcpServers": { "ChunkHound": { "command": "chunkhound", "args": [ "mcp" ], "directTools": true, "lifecycle": "eager", "requestTimeoutMs": 1200000 } }, "settings": { "outputGuard": false } } CHUNKHOUND_EOF else cat > .mcp.json <<'CHUNKHOUND_EOF' { "mcpServers": { "ChunkHound": { "command": "chunkhound", "args": [ "mcp" ], "directTools": true, "lifecycle": "eager", "requestTimeoutMs": 1200000 } }, "settings": { "outputGuard": false } } CHUNKHOUND_EOF fi # Build ChunkHound's search index for this project. chunkhound index .
